static.contactBody: Questions about this page? Email support@vertexmma.com. Vertex MMA is an independent project and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, the UFC or Zuffa LLC.
static.aboutBody: Vertex MMA is a community platform for UFC fight discussion, custom rankings, and virtual coin betting. The Vertex Score is a 0–100 measure combining quality wins, championship pedigree, recent form, finishing rate, and defensive vulnerability across every UFC fighter with three or more bouts.

aboutSections.heading: What the Vertex Score is
aboutSections.body: The Vertex Score rates each fighter from 0 to 100 from their UFC results — weighting quality wins, championship pedigree, recent form, finishing rate, activity and defensive vulnerability. Active fighters are shown on a current/divisional basis; retired fighters on an all-time basis.

aboutSections.heading: Where our data comes from
aboutSections.body: Fighter, event and bout data is compiled from publicly available UFC statistics. The news feed aggregates headlines from public RSS sources, which we automatically classify and rephrase. Model picks and simulations are our own estimates and can be wrong.

aboutSections.heading: Virtual currency
aboutSections.body: Coins are a free, in-app score for entertainment. They have no monetary value, can't be bought, sold, or cashed out, and don't represent real-money betting.

static.privacyLead: This policy explains what Vertex MMA collects, why, and the choices you have. We keep it short and collect as little as we can.

privacySections.heading: Data we collect
privacySections.body:
• Account: your email and a securely hashed password, handled by our authentication provider.
• Profile: username, display name, and any optional bio, country and avatar you add.
• Activity: your bets, parlays, custom rankings, comments and coin transaction history.
• Technical: a sign-in session cookie, your language and theme preferences, and basic server logs.

privacySections.heading: How we use it
privacySections.body: To run your account, place and settle virtual bets, compute leaderboards, tiers and achievements, display the content you create, and keep the platform secure. We do not sell your data or use it for third-party advertising.

privacySections.heading: Cookies
privacySections.body: We use a sign-in session cookie (needed to stay logged in) and small preference cookies for language and theme. We do not use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

privacySections.heading: Service providers
privacySections.body:
• Supabase provides our database, authentication and file storage, and delivers account emails such as password resets.
• Our news pipeline reads public RSS feeds and uses a large-language-model service to classify and rephrase headlines; no personal user data is sent to it.
• The app runs on our own server infrastructure.

privacySections.heading: Retention and your rights
privacySections.body: We keep your data while your account is active. You can edit your profile in Settings and delete your account at any time from Settings, which removes your profile and associated data. You can also request access or correction by email.

privacySections.heading: Children
privacySections.body: Vertex MMA is not directed at children and is intended for users who are 18 or older (or the age of majority where they live).

privacySections.heading: Changes
privacySections.body: We may update this policy; material changes will be reflected by the date above.

static.termsLead: By using Vertex MMA you agree to these terms. Please read them — especially the virtual-currency and no-warranty sections.

termsSections.heading: Your account
termsSections.body: You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your credentials safe. Provide accurate information and do not impersonate others.

termsSections.heading: Virtual currency
termsSections.body: Coins are a free, in-app feature for entertainment only. They have NO monetary value, cannot be purchased, sold, transferred, or redeemed for real money or prizes, and are not gambling. We may adjust, reset, or remove balances to correct errors or abuse.

termsSections.heading: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Do not post unlawful, hateful, harassing, or spam content; do not abuse, scrape, or attack the service; do not attempt to manipulate leaderboards, markets, or bonuses. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules.

termsSections.heading: Your content
termsSections.body: You keep ownership of the rankings, comments and other content you create, and grant us a licence to display it within the platform. You are responsible for what you post.

termsSections.heading: No warranty
termsSections.body: The Vertex Score, model picks and simulations are informational estimates — not predictions or betting advice — and may be inaccurate or out of date. The service is provided "as is", without warranties.

termsSections.heading: Liability
termsSections.body: To the extent permitted by law, Vertex MMA is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of the service.

termsSections.heading: Changes
termsSections.body: We may update these terms; continued use after a change means you accept it.

simulationIndex.metaTitle: Vertex MMA Simulation — predictions for every upcoming UFC bout
simulationIndex.metaDescription: ML-powered winner predictions, SHAP feature attributions, and Monte Carlo round-by-round distributions for every scheduled UFC bout.
simulationIndex.heading: Simulation
simulationIndex.lead: Calibrated winner probabilities, top driving features, and Monte Carlo round-by-round distributions for every scheduled UFC bout.
simulationIndex.accuracyCaveat: The model performs at roughly market level — its edge over simply picking the betting favourite is small, and graded picks skew toward more predictable matchups.
simulationIndex.emptyFilteredLead: No upcoming bouts pass the current filter. Try a looser combination or wait for the next card to lock in.
simulationIndex.emptyLead: The model runs every night against the schedule. Once the next card is locked in, predictions will appear here.
simulationIndex.disclaimer: Predictions come from a LightGBM + XGBoost + LogReg ensemble trained on every historical UFC bout with isotonic-style calibration, plus a 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulator for the per-round distribution. Reflects statistical baseline only — not a betting recommendation.
simulationIndex.customCtaLead: Pick any two fighters — each at the form from any bout of their career — and let the model score it.
